title: The Sky Poison Woman
summary: At the Black Mountain Fortress, the leader of the Poison Sect arrives and takes over the attack on the Jia Ma Empire. She sends the beaten Three Elders of Mulan back to base, recognises Xiao Yan as the man the Hall of Souls wants, and orders Yan Luo Tian to bring him in alive while she fights Medusa. Xiao Yan fights Yan Luo Tian, dodges his Open Mountain Seal with clones, and maims him with the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Xiao Yan then recognises the Poison Sect leader as his old friend Little Fairy Doctor, who now calls herself the Sky Poison Woman. She says the Woeful Poison Body has killed everyone she cared about, and she lets it loose as a cloud of poison gas. Xiao Yan refuses to leave her.
